calculators.title_en: Sweden Net Salary & Income Tax Calculator
search_terms_native: hur mycket skatt betalar jag på min lön
calculators.description_native: Beräkna din nettolön efter kommunalskatt, statlig inkomstskatt, jobbskatteavdrag, grundavdrag samt kyrko- och begravningsavgift baserat på din hemkommun och ålder.
calculators.formula_explanation:
1. Gross Annual Income = Monthly Gross Salary × 12.
2. Basic Deduction (Grundavdrag): Calculated via Skatteverket formulas based on Price Base Amount (Prisbasbelopp PBB = 58,800 SEK for 2026). Ranges between ~16,800 SEK and ~40,500 SEK for earners under 66, and enhanced basic deduction up to ~130,000 SEK for earners aged 66+.
3. Taxable Earned Income = Gross Annual Income - Grundavdrag.
4. Municipal Tax (Kommunalskatt): Municipal Tax Rate % × Taxable Earned Income. (Includes municipal + regional tax + burial fee + optional church fee).
5. Earned Income Tax Credit (Jobbskatteavdrag): Calculated as a direct credit against municipal tax based on earned income and PBB. Extended in 2026 with no high-income taper reduction.
6. State Income Tax (Statlig inkomstskatt): 20% on Taxable Earned Income exceeding the skiktgräns (643,000 SEK taxable income / brytpunkt 660,400 SEK gross annual income for under 66; 760,500 SEK gross annual income for age 66+).
7. Total Personal Income Tax = Municipal Tax - Jobbskatteavdrag + State Income Tax.
8. Net Annual Income = Gross Annual Income - Total Personal Income Tax. Net Monthly Take-Home Pay = Net Annual Income / 12.

calculators.formula_explanation:
1. Employer Social Security Contributions (Arbetsgivaravgifter): 31.42% of Gross Director Salary. Total Payroll Cost = Gross Salary × 1.3142.
2. Taxable Corporate Profit = Company Gross Profit - Total Payroll Cost - Business Expenses.
3. Corporate Tax (Bolagsskatt): 20.6% × Taxable Corporate Profit. Net Distributable Profit = Taxable Corporate Profit × (1 - 0.206).
4. K10 Dividend Allowance (Gränsbelopp):
   - 2025 Förenklingsregeln: 2.75 × Inkomstbasbelopp (IBB) (209,550 SEK for 2025) × Ownership Share %.
   - 2025 Huvudregeln: 50% of qualifying company payroll (subject to owner salary requirement: 6 IBB + 5% payroll or 9.6 IBB) × Ownership Share %.
   - 2026 Unified Model: Base threshold (4 IBB = 322,400 SEK for 2026) + Salary-based space (payroll minus 8 IBB deduction) × Ownership Share %.
5. Dividend Taxation:
   - Dividends within Gränsbelopp: Taxed at favorable 20% capital rate (2/3 of 30%).
   - Dividends exceeding Gränsbelopp (up to 90 IBB cap): Taxed as earned income (tjänsteinkomst) at marginal tax rate (~32-52%), but exempt from employer contributions.
   - Dividends exceeding 90 IBB: Taxed at standard 30% capital tax rate.
6. Total Net Combined Take-Home = Net Director Salary (after income tax & jobbskatteavdrag) + Net Distributed Dividends (after 20% / marginal dividend tax).

calculators.description_native: Beräkna nettoinkomst, egenavgifter (28,97%), schablonavdrag, kommunalskatt och jobbskatteavdrag för enskild näringsverksamhet och egenanställda frilansare.

inputs.name: gross_revenue_annual
inputs.label_native: Årlig omsättning / fakturerat belopp exkl. moms (SEK)

calculators.formula_explanation:
1. Gross Business Operating Profit = Annual Gross Revenues - Business Expenses. (If umbrella employment, deduct umbrella commission fee of ~6% first).
2. Allocation to Tax Allocation Reserve (Periodiseringsfond): Maximum 30% of operating profit can be deferred for up to 6 tax years. Net Business Profit (Överskott) = Operating Profit - Tax Reserve Deduction.
3. Standard Allowance for Social Contributions (Schablonavdrag för egenavgifter): 25% standard deduction on Net Profit for age <67 (or 10% for age 67+). Estimated Taxable Base = Net Business Profit / 1.25.
4. Self-Employed Social Security Contributions (Egenavgifter): 28.97% × Estimated Taxable Base (or 10.21% pension fee for age 67+).
5. Taxable Earned Income (Beskattningsbar förvärvsinkomst) = Net Business Profit - Actual Egenavgifter - Basic Deduction (Grundavdrag).
6. Personal Income Tax = Municipal Tax Rate × Taxable Earned Income - Jobbskatteavdrag + State Income Tax (20% above 643,000 SEK taxable income threshold).
7. Net Take-Home Freelance Income = Net Business Profit - Actual Egenavgifter - Personal Income Tax.

calculators.description_native: Beräkna vinstskatt (22%) vid försäljning av bostad, avdragsgilla renoveringar och mäklararvodet, uppskovsmöjligheter samt köparens stämpelskatt för lagfart (1,5%) och pantbrev (2%).

inputs.label_native: Belopp för nya pantbrev vid köp (SEK) [Gäller endast Fastighet]

calculators.formula_explanation:
1. Gross Capital Profit = Sale Price - Purchase Price.
2. Total Allowable Deductions = Broker Commission + Sales Marketing Expenses + Qualified Renovation Expenses (Grundförbättringar full value within last 5 years + Reparationer/Underhåll bringing property to improved standard).
3. Net Capital Gain (Vinst/Förlust) = Gross Capital Profit - Total Allowable Deductions.
4. Capital Gains Tax on Private Residence (Vinstskatt privatbostad): Taxed at 22% effective rate (22/30 of profit subject to 30% capital tax). If capital loss, tax reduction is 50% of loss up to 100,000 SEK, plus 30% on loss exceeding 100,000 SEK.
5. Tax Deferral (Uppskov med vinstskatt): Sellers purchasing a replacement dwelling can defer up to 3,000,000 SEK of capital gains. Annual deferral tax rate is 0% (abolished since 2021).
6. Stamp Duty on Property Ownership Transfer (Stämpelskatt för lagfart): 1.5% of Sale Price (or tax assessment value if higher) + 825 SEK registration fee for individuals (4.25% for corporate buyers).
7. New Mortgage Deed Fee (Pantbrev): 2% of new mortgage deed amount issued + 375 SEK administration fee per pantbrev.

calculators.formula_explanation:
1. Gross Invoice Amount = Labor Cost + Material and Travel Expenses.
2. Potential ROT Tax Reduction: 30% × Labor Cost. Maximum ROT cap = 50,000 SEK per person per tax year.
3. Potential RUT Tax Reduction: 50% × Labor Cost. Maximum total combined ROT + RUT cap = 75,000 SEK per person per tax year.
4. Household Combined Capacity: Max ROT ceiling = 50,000 SEK × Number of Eligible Owners. Max total ROT+RUT ceiling = 75,000 SEK × Number of Eligible Owners.
5. Remaining Household Allowance: ROT Cap Remaining = Min(50,000 SEK - Previous ROT, 75,000 SEK - Total Previous ROT+RUT) × Owners. RUT Cap Remaining = (75,000 SEK - Total Previous ROT+RUT) × Owners.
6. Granted Tax Reduction = Min(Potential Tax Reduction, Remaining Allowance). Note: Tax reduction is limited by individual's total paid municipal/state tax for the year.
7. Customer Payable Net Amount = Gross Invoice Amount - Granted Tax Reduction.
